title: Frogs Jump
statement: In a 2×n grid (n up to 2·10^5) with no empty column, the task is the fewest frogs to remove so the rest can each jump one cell, in-grid, keeping every row and column count. Up and down jumps must balance and each column boundary's crossings cancel, so survivors are even; pairing frogs in the same or next column always works, so the answer is the frog count mod 2.
